review_candidates.title: Product Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: ● Run discovery with clients and internal stakeholders to understand their problems, processes, requirements, and success criteria. ● Scope custom client projects, estimate requirements with engineering, write proposals, and manage change requests to keep scope and delivery under control. ● Coordinate client implementations from requirements gathering through development, testing, UAT, launch, and handover.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: ● Run discovery with clients and internal stakeholders to understand their problems, processes, requirements, and success criteria. ● Work hands-on with LLM-based features: design and test prompts, evaluate outputs, identify failure cases, and improve quality over time. ● Scope custom client projects, estimate requirements with engineering, write proposals, and manage change requests to keep scope and delivery under control. ● Coordinate client implementations from requirements gathering through development, testing, UAT, launch, and handover. What We're Looking For ● 3-5 years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, AI, or enterprise software. ● Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI product evaluation.
